name: Objectives Rewards
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Track campaign conjunction of three actual Crown fragments and defeated lich_king, four once-only milestone triggers, dungeon clear and generated room claims. Bind reward settlement to the actual occurrence, victory, recipient and allowed checkpoint. Distinguish a repeatable random table roll from reopening the same event occurrence; never mint a second object/currency grant on resume.

blockers: Monster loot metadata does not prove payment. Quest-board reward metadata has no EventDialog consumer; no post-combat bounty settlement found. claim_reward exists but its call sites outside its declaration are harness checks, not actual payouts. Dungeon clear uses cleared_dungeons and a separate payout route. Inventory-full/lost grant, child-event continuation and normal creation-to-finale proof remain unverified.
reuse_boundary: Existing accepted pieces remain accepted at their documented limits; these requirements do not mark the entire slices missing.
